sources.lights: The lights of the matched golfer showpiece clips (round 14, 2026-11-21), which replace the scene's own three spot lights and the export sun. Every light is directional (direction of travel, world frame, z up), so level ground is as bright at the horizon as at the tee. The key is four weak shadow-casting lights a degree or two apart: MuJoCo has no soft shadows, and four offset hard shadows give the cast shadow a graded edge. The warm fill beside the key and the cool rim from behind the trail side shape the body without a second shadow; the low front light lifts the face and the hands. Diffuse and specular are linear RGB in [0, 1].
sources.headlight: Camera headlight of the showpiece clips: a high ambient term (the face read dark below it in round 13) and a weak diffuse term. Specular is the studio value of the scene.
sources.shadow: shadowsize is the shadow map edge in texels (power of two). extent_m is the model extent MuJoCo scales the shadow map and clip planes by, and shadowclip the half width of a directional light's map in extents: 1.0 x 3 m keeps the whole swing inside the map at about 0.4 mm per texel, where the smaller map drew saw-tooth shadow edges on skin.
sources.ground: texture_gain multiplies the two checker colours of the ground texture (clipped to 1); 1.6 was chosen on the showpiece stills so the turf reads as mown grass under the weaker direct light. checker_contrast is the share of the difference between the two checker colours that is kept (0.35: the squares stay readable as a ground cue without flicker in motion). reflectance 0 stops the turf mirroring the shoes.
